name: G4 Real-Task Work-Tree Debug
suiteRoleNote: Intentionally pre-configures nested takeoverProtocol/workTree state to validate child->sibling->root continuation, failed-leaf bubble, approval stops, and work-tree delivery semantics. Not a default real-task planning template.

conventions.exemptionReason: Runtime semantic verification requires an explicitly seeded takeoverProtocol, nested work tree path, and prescribed debug report structure per real-task-test-conventions-v0.1 §4.

cases.title: G4 Real Task Work-Tree Debug - LongCat Short 64k
cases.taskGoal: Review the current Project Yggdrasil repository and produce a work-tree debug report for a real task run. The report must first state the intended work-tree model, then reconstruct the actual execution path across windows, then judge where runtime behavior diverges from the intended stack semantics. Focus on currentNodeId, WorkContextStack, child completion or failure bubbling, and approval gating. Treat provider locking as incidental unless it directly changes the work-tree judgment.
cases.currentObjective: Use the current repo state to judge whether the runtime work tree behaves like the intended execution stack under a real-task short window.

currentContext.title: debug scope contract
currentContext.content: This is a real-task work-tree debugging run. Provider lock is incidental. The main question is whether the runtime behaves like the intended work-tree execution stack rather than a root-only release-brief generator.

currentContext.title: required output structure
currentContext.content: The final structure must be: 1) 目标工作树模型, 2) 实际执行路径, 3) 节点与窗口一致性, 4) 失败与上浮语义, 5) approval 与完成语义, 6) 差距判断, 7) 下一步. Section 6 must explicitly state 一致 or 不一致.

currentContext.title: window evidence policy
currentContext.content: Judge the runtime against the intended work-tree model by comparing node pointer, WorkContextStack top frame, Working_Node annotation, retrieval node pointer, and continuation behavior across windows. Distinguish normal sibling or parent continuation from root-only failure shortcuts.

currentContext.title: delivery mode contract
currentContext.content: Tool execution is disabled for this case. Treat the provided anchors as the evidence set. Do not describe future scanning or tool usage. Preserve the seeded currentNodeId / Working_Node / WorkContextStack semantics first; if the current node is a child, finish that child and bubble to the parent before final root-level synthesis. The final report must still use these exact section headings: '## 1. 目标工作树模型', '## 2. 实际执行路径', '## 3. 节点与窗口一致性', '## 4. 失败与上浮语义', '## 5. approval 与完成语义', '## 6. 差距判断', '## 7. 下一步'.

cases.responseRequirements: Produce the complete work-tree debug report directly, but treat the seeded currentNodeId / Working_Node / WorkContextStack as authoritative. If the current node is child-1, first complete and bubble child-1 semantics, then let the parent/root synthesize the final report. Required sections: 1) 目标工作树模型, 2) 实际执行路径, 3) 节点与窗口一致性, 4) 失败与上浮语义, 5) approval 与完成语义, 6) 差距判断 (must explicitly state 一致 or 不一致), 7) 下一步. Treat the provided anchors as the complete evidence set. Output Markdown only. Do not emit XML tags, tool tags, MCP tags, <tool_calls>, or planning preambles. Do not stop at planning or next-steps summary.
cases.restartMessage: Window continuation: continue the work-tree debug report and keep the same seven sections, while preserving the seeded currentNodeId / Working_Node / WorkContextStack semantics. If the current node is child-1, first finish child-1 and bubble to the parent before root-level synthesis. Reuse the intended work-tree model, compare it against the actual execution path, and make an explicit 一致/不一致 judgment. Output Markdown only and do not emit XML/tool/MCP tags.
